CoSky 6.1 makes service status and weights work with Spring Cloud, speeds up cached discovery, and rewrites the [documentation](https://cosky.ahoo.me/) around what readers need to do.

## Behavior changes

- **Spring Cloud discovery returns only `UP` instances.** An instance whose `instance_status` metadata is anything other than `UP` (e.g. after `ServiceRegistry.setStatus(OUT_OF_SERVICE)`) no longer receives traffic; instances without a status are unaffected. Set `spring.cloud.cosky.discovery.filter-only-up-instances=false` to restore the previous behavior.
- **No remote JMX by default.** The REST API server's start script and Docker image no longer open JMX on port 5555 (it had no authentication). Add the JMX options to `JAVA_OPTS` if you need it.

## Highlights

- **Weights for Spring Cloud LoadBalancer:** each instance's weight is exposed as the `weight` metadata; enable `spring.cloud.loadbalancer.configurations=weighted` to route by it.
- **Faster cached discovery:** `getInstances` from the local cache is about 8× faster under concurrent load ([performance](https://cosky.ahoo.me/guide/performance)).
- **Fixes:** `spring.cloud.cosky.enabled=false` no longer breaks applications using the config starter; unknown routes and unsupported methods return 404 / 405 instead of 400; the Kubernetes manifests run the current image and read secrets from Kubernetes Secrets.
- **Documentation:** restructured into guides, operations, reference and concepts, in English and Chinese. Getting Started now includes `spring-cloud-starter-bootstrap`, without which `bootstrap.yaml` is ignored.
- **Engineering:** stricter static analysis and license checks, an end-to-end REST API test, a 90% line coverage floor, pull request labeling, and automated releases.

Upgrading from 5.x? Read the [6.0 upgrade guide](https://cosky.ahoo.me/guide/upgrade-6) first.
